predicted_impacts.reason: ECR-005 names CHR-001 as the primary component and proposes increasing its baseline power from 3.3 kW to 5 kW.
PLM explicitly states CHR-001 charges BAT-001; battery charge acceptance at the changed charger capability requires verification.
CHG-001 is explicitly related to CHR-001 as an interface, but its recorded AC-inlet description does not establish a 5 kW rating.
REQ-007 specifies on-board charging power with a 3.3 kW baseline matching the charger baseline; review for the proposed 5 kW target.
The published charge-time target may be affected by changed charger power, but its stored value is non-numeric.
BAT-001 is explicitly managed by BMS-001; the recorded peak-current specification does not confirm charging-current compatibility.
BAT-001 is explicitly cooled by THM-001; the available plate specification does not establish thermal adequacy at increased charging power.
The released PROD-X1 BOM contains CHR-001 Rev A and may need configuration revision if the changed charger is approved.
TEST-005 is a passed charging-performance test linked to REQ-017; its record does not validate the changed charger configuration.
SUP-006 is the approved supplier associated with CHR-001; capability for the proposed changed charger is not established.
MFG-007 records charger integration; review the process for the changed charger before production release.
